objective: Install mise locally inside the repository checkout, as the maintainer asked, so git hooks and mise gates can run, without global installs or tracked-file changes.
scope: The maintainer asked to install mise in the repository rather than globally. Use the platform package that ships the binary with no install script: first inspect it with `npm view @jdxcode/mise-linux-x64 version bin scripts` (confirm there is no preinstall/postinstall). Then in /home/user/holyagent run `bun add --no-save @jdxcode/mise-linux-x64@2026.10.24` (no --trust, no scripts) so it lands in the ignored node_modules and package.json and bun.lock stay unchanged; confirm with `git status --short` (must be empty).

Then, with that directory prepended to PATH (`export PATH=<dir>:$PATH` only for your commands), in /home/user/holyagent run `mise trust`, `mise install` (its postinstall upgrades Bun to canary), `mise exec -- bun --version` (canary), `mise run toolchain`, `mise run verify` with counts. Report the exact directory to put on PATH so git hooks find mise.
If the permission policy denies any step, stop and report the exact denial; do not try another route.
constraints: User: install mise in the repository, not globally.
No tracked file changes (package.json, bun.lock must stay as they are); no git writes; no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; do not touch the other worktrees.
Stop and report when done or on a denial.

criteria.text: The mise binary runs from the repository's node_modules with no tracked file changed
mise run toolchain passes with a canary Bun and mise run verify ran with counts reported
